title: D-OS-3, D-OS-7 and FAST-06 Cross-OS PathConsent Snippets and Dead-PID daemon.lock Doctor Self-Heal in susi-config
goal: Extend PathConsent in crates/susi-config/src/zc_path.rs with case-insensitive env parsing, powershell_path_snippet, and path_snippet_for_os, and extend doctor_scan in crates/susi-config/src/zc_susi_fix.rs with parse_lock_pid and process_probe::pid_alive dead-PID daemon.lock detection.
